name: What is the typical lifespan of new carpet?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of new carpet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of new carpet varies based on fiber type, padding quality, and foot traffic. Nylon and wool carpets generally last longer, often 10-15 years or more, especially with proper maintenance. Polyester and olefin options may have a shorter lifespan, typically 5-10 years. Regular vacuuming and professional cleaning can extend the life of any carpet.
acceptedAnswer.description: Carpet lifespan varies by fiber type, padding, and foot traffic, typically 5-15 years. Proper maintenance extends its life.
